test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Inayat did not greet her.

options.text: She was not going to be greeted by Inayat.
She was not at all greeted by Inayat.
She was not greeted by Inayat.
She was not being greeted by Inayat.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Inayat did not greet her."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "her" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "did not greet" to "was not greeted" (simple past passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Inayat."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She was not greeted by Inayat."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"She was not going to be greeted by Inayat." – Incorrect tense and structure.
 
• **Option 2: **"She was not at all greeted by Inayat." – Adds unnecessary emphasis, changing the meaning slightly.
 
• **Option 4: **"She was not being greeted by Inayat." – Incorrect continuous tense.
